t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are always two gnomes, they have different colours, each gnome send you to his kind of forest, you need to get as many mashrooms as possible, the number of mashrooms is different for every forest but it's also changing

vb_textbox.text: There are two forests, and two gnomes, some gnomes take to forest with red basket and some to forest with yellow basket, for example yellow gnome takes you to forest with yellow basket. Number of mushroom in each forest is changing , so there is no better nor worst forest, if you keep on going to just one forest the number of mushrooms starts declining and it means it's time to go to the other one, just like in a real life, mushroom needs time to grow . The point is to find the right balance and moment , when it's time to change the forest
